### What happened?
A clear and concise description of the problem.

### Expected behaviour
What did you expect to happen instead?

### Steps to reproduce
1. Go to ...
2. Click on ...

### Severity
- [ ] Low – cosmetic or minor inconvenience
- [ ] Medium – feature partially broken, workaround available
- [ ] High – feature broken, no workaround
- [ ] Critical – outage, data loss or blocks all users

### Environment
Where did this happen? (e.g. production / staging, iOS Safari 18, Chrome 130 on macOS)
